correctness.rationale: The generator matches Example 1. An exact independent finite reproduction confirmed all 84 three-column subsets are independent. On each surviving subset, evaluate the six quadratic monomials modulo 17 on (1,t^3,t^4). Rank below six detects a conic; no three points are collinear, so a singular conic (two lines over the algebraic closure, possibly coincident) cannot contain five of them. A smooth conic can be projectively parametrized with an unused rational point at infinity, giving an ordinary GRS code up to monomial equivalence; GRS columns conversely lie on such a conic. The independent enumeration of all 256 surviving sets gave rank-(5,6) counts (0,1),(0,9),(0,36),(6,78),(126,0) in descending size order. The six deletion triples matched exactly: {4,10,16}, {3,7,9}, {3,5,16}, {2,5,9}, {2,4,7}, and {0,2,3}. Hence the least puncturing depth is three. Replay: the frozen verify.py specifies the finite instance; independently, enumerate the subsets of S and row-reduce the rows (1,t^6,t^8,t^3,t^4,t^7) modulo 17.
residual_risks: The census concerns puncturing this exact code with at least five surviving coordinates, not shortening or other members of the family.

evidence: The indexed theorem handles evaluation spans <1,x,x^3> and <1,x^2,x^3>, each on a cubic with a rational cusp (Y^3=X^2 Z or Y^3=X Z^2).

Exact cubic evaluation on the nine Example 1 columns has rank 9; in the monomial order X^3,X^2Y,X^2Z,XY^2,XYZ,XZ^2,Y^3,Y^2Z,YZ^2,Z^3 a generator of the nullspace is (0,6,4,12,8,5,4,2,6,1). None of its three-gradient zeroes is a point of PG(2,17), as checked on (1,y,z), (0,1,z), and (0,0,1).
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: A monomial equivalence of the full codes would induce a projectivity taking their arcs to one another, hence would supply a rationally singular cubic containing this arc. The unique cubic through it has no rational singular point, ruling out that reduction. The conic and dimension-three Schur-square formulations give the same tested invariant, not distinct novelty.

value.rationale: Puncturing to GRS is a natural recovery invariant of the published explicit non-GRS MDS example. Knowing that three punctures are necessary and sufficient, and which six choices work, tells a reader how robust its non-GRS property is under deletion; neither the general recognition test nor the automatic five-point case gives that information. The contribution is finite and example-specific.
residual_risks: No family-wide threshold or broader application is established.
